Maya: Hey @Ashwin @Sam K — I opened a tiny hotfix to reduce kv-proxy backoff after this morning's latency spike. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4123 Can someone take a quick look? We want a canary by ~09:45 UTC (about 30m) to avoid affecting in-flight requests.
DeployBot: New PR opened by Maya: infra#4123 — CI queued, lint + unit tests running.
Ashwin: Taking a look now. Can you paste the failing trace or repro steps you saw?
Maya: Repro was intermittent but here's the most common stack in prod logs: ```[WARN] 2026-03-17T08:02:14Z kv-proxy backoff exceeded for peer=id-23, retries=7, last_delay=12.5s``` Change is tiny in kv_backoff.go: ```// clamp backoff so we don't stall the request loop if peer is unhealthy
if backoff > maxBackoff { backoff = maxBackoff } 
// reduce upper bound slightly to avoid exponential blowup during transient thundering
if backoff > 8s { backoff = 8s }
``` Shouldn't change correctness, just reduces worst-case delay.
Sam K: Quick skim — looks reasonable. Two nits: add a short comment referencing the incident id and add a jitter unit test. But for emergency canary i can +1 if Ashwin is OK.
Jin: Oncall here — good call getting this out. Please also open a revert PR so we can rollback quickly if canary shows regressions.
Maya: Revert PR created: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4124 (rollback to previous backoff behavior).
Ashwin: Code lgtm; small risk. Approving now. @DeployBot can you kick off a canary deploy for infra/kV-proxy with infra#4123 as the commit?
DeployBot: Canary job started for infra/kv-proxy (PR 4123) — jobs: canary-unit, canary-smoke. Estimated 10m.
DeployBot: Canary completed: canary-smoke OK, 0 errors across sampled traffic, latency improved p95 18% vs baseline. CI: all checks passed.
Maya: Merging to main and monitoring. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Sam K: Nice work — :eyes: on metrics for the next 20m.
Jin: I'll watch errors and revert if anything spikes. Ping me if you see >1% error rate.
Maya: Will do. If we need a revert, link is infra#4124. Cheers.
